review_meta.overall_reason: The 15 FAIL verdicts are not substantiated by committed, reproducible evidence. Every row's evidence_ref is the artifact file itself (self-referential); the claimed probe outputs ('87117 bytes', 'distinctive label=False/True') appear nowhere else in the committed tree (no harness, no raw capture). 14/15 rows are demoted to NOT_TESTED (unsubstantiated regression from a substantiated prior PASS / NOT_TESTED). Two rows have definitive internal defects (TBL-25 self-contradiction; PAGE-02 conflates NOT_TESTED with FAIL). The probe is strictly weaker than the matrix's required DOM-capture + independent-oracle + negative-tests methodology. I could not DISPROVE the FAILs (no live re-probe is possible from here), so per the rule 'where you cannot disprove a claim, say so explicitly rather than silently endorsing it', I record the honest verdict NOT_TESTED rather than endorse an unsubstantiated FAIL.
defects: D1 Self-referential evidence_ref on all 15 rows: each row cites the artifact file itself; no independent committed evidence.

D2 Unreproducible numbers: '87117 bytes' and 'distinctive label' exist ONLY in this JSON (git grep over committed tree); no committed harness or raw response capture emits them; cannot recompute (Check #4 fails).

D3 TBL-13..TBL-24 share identical boilerplate (only the column-name string differs); a single page-level 'absent' observation relabelled 12 ways, and weaker than the matrix's oracle+DOM methodology for a regression claim against a substantiated prior PASS.
D4 TBL-25 internal contradiction: text says 'distinctive label=True' (control present) yet verdict FAIL on 'control absent'.

D5 PAGE-02 conflates NOT_TESTED with FAIL: text states the required reset/snapshot safety and error-banner behaviors 'are not demonstrated' (i.e. not run); a predicate that never executed cannot fail (vacuous check).

D6 Process-rule gap: serving_process.started_at_utc/pid not recorded in this artifact (the sibling UI_LCC_AUD_REC_WS_8031.json records them); commit-to-serving-process binding unverifiable from this artifact.
D7 Branch advanced past the reported head: implementer reported 3e59b35; branch tip is a56b8eb (unreviewed newer commit, different artifact).
